response: Let’s be completely clear about what decades of systemic neglect and external economic hostility have done to the working people of Cuba. We are looking at a profound crisis where ordinary families, through no fault of their own, have been stripped of the wealth and stability they need to build generational security. The local population has been left entirely vulnerable to predatory outside forces. Now, we see the inevitable result of these structural pressures: a wealthy diaspora and foreign investors are waiting in the wings to swoop in and buy up property and businesses at bargain prices, destroying the cultural continuity of the homeland. Without institutional protections, property ownership, and true self-reliance for workers on the ground, the people are being set up for exploitation by vulture capitalists and outside economic forces looking to cash in on human suffering.
